env.installPhase:
runHook preInstall
node apps/system/boot/scripts/bundle-boot.mjs "$PWD" "$out/lib/moire-boot"
mkdir -p $out/share/moire-boot $out/bin
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/nix/store/q6l09gpmdqb0drp3wsxlcmzqjh2z3n9b-libdrm-2.4.133/lib:/nix/store/bjk38qs79irxsjl0557nckcn014qld31-gcc-15.3.0-lib/lib \
  node $out/lib/moire-boot/src/entry/generate-assets.mjs \
  $out/share/moire-boot/silk-fold.rgba
makeWrapper /nix/store/rrv7n5jlmsqamhsy1i5dmz40bwnvg5g1-nodejs-slim-22.23.3/bin/node $out/bin/moire-boot \
  --add-flags "$out/lib/moire-boot/src/entry/guardian.mjs" \
  --set MOIRE_BOOT_RENDERER "$out/lib/moire-boot/src/entry/renderer.mjs" \
  --set MOIRE_BOOT_ARTWORK "$out/share/moire-boot/silk-fold.rgba" \
  --prefix LD_LIBRARY_PATH : /nix/store/q6l09gpmdqb0drp3wsxlcmzqjh2z3n9b-libdrm-2.4.133/lib:/nix/store/bjk38qs79irxsjl0557nckcn014qld31-gcc-15.3.0-lib/lib
makeWrapper /nix/store/rrv7n5jlmsqamhsy1i5dmz40bwnvg5g1-nodejs-slim-22.23.3/bin/node $out/bin/moire-boot-smoke \
  --add-flags "$out/lib/moire-boot/src/entry/guardian-smoke.mjs"
makeWrapper /nix/store/rrv7n5jlmsqamhsy1i5dmz40bwnvg5g1-nodejs-slim-22.23.3/bin/node $out/bin/moire-boot-view-smoke \
  --add-flags "$out/lib/moire-boot/src/entry/view-smoke.mjs" \
  --prefix LD_LIBRARY_PATH : /nix/store/q6l09gpmdqb0drp3wsxlcmzqjh2z3n9b-libdrm-2.4.133/lib:/nix/store/bjk38qs79irxsjl0557nckcn014qld31-gcc-15.3.0-lib/lib
runHook postInstall
env.name: moire-boot-0.0.0
